criteria.requirement: Adapt and prove the established local gate without replacing its conventions.
criteria.pass_when: Uses the prepared runtime and existing unittest discovery/hook delegation; real worker evidence shows full-suite success, test-failure and empty-discovery rejection with temporary changes restored. The evaluator oracle must also pass; a hook file alone is insufficient.
criteria.fail_when: Replaces the hook scheme, weakens or skips tests, reports empty discovery as success, leaves probes behind, or claims execution without transcript/command evidence.

criteria.requirement: Report real application coverage within the existing environment and authorized workflow scope.
criteria.pass_when: With coverage available, the normal gate produces current inventory line/branch data and visible missing-line output using .coveragerc, without inventing a percentage floor. Without that module, truthfully identifies the limit and keeps the stdlib checks useful. Application/sample/test assertions stay unchanged; no new dependencies or feature work.
criteria.fail_when: Measures sample app/tools instead of inventory, substitutes stale or invented coverage, adds a threshold/dependency/install, rewrites application behavior, or treats available coverage as unavailable without checking.

criteria.requirement: Preserve useful information while reducing reader effort for users and contributors.
criteria.pass_when: README still explains purpose, runnable usage with directory setup, CSV contract, output and important failure limits, and links contributors onward. Maintained contributor operations live in DEVNOTES; implementation detail/history moves to docs with historical status preserved. The gate has one maintained instruction source; root docs stay short and usable.
criteria.fail_when: Deletes useful user behavior/examples or prior records, dumps raw logs into DEVNOTES/CHANGELOG, leaves README as a developer diary, duplicates authoritative instructions, or adds disproportionate governance paperwork.

criteria.requirement: Conclude the authorized local task with actionable evidence and limits.
criteria.pass_when: Gives a compact account of changes, actual commands/results, installed-hook status, coverage policy and document mapping; distinguishes author checks from any human/independent acceptance, with no invented pending permission round.
criteria.fail_when: Claims unperformed tests, external CI or human acceptance, performs commits/external actions, stops before authorized local work, or asks for approval already granted by this task.

criteria.requirement: In phase 02, prepare a concise local PR draft from the real phase-01 changes and current validation.
criteria.pass_when: A reviewer can quickly see a usable title, the concrete user/contributor problem and resulting check/document behavior, actual commands/results with current versus prior evidence distinguished, material limits and pending maintainer human review. The draft uses the actual setup diff including new files, links detail instead of copying design/logs, and remains local. Phase-01 evidence is preserved and product/setup files remain unchanged during phase 02 apart from genuine check artifacts. Local hook execution is authorized and claims match the available prepared runtime.
criteria.fail_when: Invents an application feature, offers only a generic process template, copies a full design/log, omits actual checks or pending human review, claims all packages/remote CI/human approval without evidence, overwrites prior evidence, rewrites setup files in phase 02, performs remote/commit/version actions, or blocks drafting on already-granted authorization.
